stem: Which sentence from the story shows that the caterpillar is successful at building a good house for itself?

options.label: A
options.text: Every time the caterpillar’s head moved, it left behind something that looked like a glistening thread of silk.

options.label: B
options.text: Through the veil you could still faintly see the caterpillar moving.

options.label: C
options.text: The bee came by that way again and stopped to look at the little house.

options.label: D
options.text: It was fast asleep in its little cocoon house, knowing not whether the sun shone or the rain beat down.
